Before you remix, please make sure that you followed all the rules:

Only @BarryFans, @ZYellow, @Burgnew_On_A_Laptop, @Twin138956Scratch, @MisterChuChu, and @ScratchTeen9300 (as well as their other accounts) are allowed to break these rules.

Rules marked with a (!) can only be broken by BarryFans, nobody else!

(!) 1. Remember REMIX ETIQUETTE: Comment "Remixing..." in the comments before starting a remix, so people know not to accidentally split the remix tree's branches. If you don't intend to make a new remix branch, then don't remix if someone has commented "Remixing...".

(!) 2. DO NOT BREAK SCRATCH'S COMMUNITY GUIDELINES!! That means nothing too scary or vulgar & no swear words!

3. Don't add or remove anyone from the breaking rules list without permission! Furthermore, don't delete any of these rules or instructions & don't completely change the project title either!

4. Don't delete or destructively modify anything you didn't make! You are allowed to do this though if something breaks any rules or the Community Guidelines or if you need to fix a bug or glitch.

5. Don't make your characters too large, that would make it hard to see. I would suggest scaling your character IN THE COSTUME EDITOR to match the size of the other characters before making your other costumes.

(!) 6. (PLEASE respect ZYellow's opinion on this) Please DON'T add any content from FNF, that means no characters, references, AND music tracks from that game. The reason why this rule exists is because FNF was involved in an incident with the New Oddball Mirror Hall. That incident caused problems for ZYellow much later and it tarnished his opinion on that game (if you like that game, then ZYellow respects your opinion).

7. Please refrain from adding any static images for characters, even if you attempt animate them, background included or not (EG: A PNG or JPEG of a Minecraft mob or some other thing).

8. I don't recommend adding any singular characters that appear to be 2 separate characters (EG: Mario & Luigi both as 1 character), unless they are stuck together with no feasible way to physically detach them OR if one of them appears in a stunned costume of the other.

9. Don't delete any music tracks unless they break the Community Guidelines. If you don't want to listen to a certain song or genre, utilize the "audio exemption" functionality to make sure you can't.

10. On the topic of music, please also refer to the Music comment's recommended music limit so that it can't have too much lag from this project.

11. You can add yourself to the thumbnail, but please don't delete any characters off it or completely change it altogether! I also recommend that you group your characters to prevent clutter.

^~xvPH]U$hPvE+{TFT?9.text:
===== HOW TO REMIX =====
Want to add a character to this project? Follow these instructions carefully to get them in:
1. Scroll down below these instructions & read the rules! DON'T proceed until you've done this!

2. Click the green "Remix" button at the top-right corner.

3. Create a duplicate of the "Player0" sprite. (right-click the sprite on the sprite list, then click "duplicate")

4. Create your character! Replace every costume in the duplicated sprite with your character, replace all "Voice" sound clips (at the bottom of the sound list) with your character's voice & set their name, walk animation settings, and size.

5. Test your project &, if you like the result, either continue to add more characters or share it!
BONUS: You're also allowed to add characters to the thumbnail & add more music tracks.

BARREL EXTRAVAGANZA: SUMMER EDITION -- List of Barrel Types
This is a list of all of the barrels that the players would encounter in a game of Barrel Extravaganza: Summer Edition. The barrels all have a falling and rolling variant.

BARREL (brown): The basic type of barrel. Starts spawning at the start of the game. Deals -1 HP.

LIGHT BARREL (periwinkle): Falls slower than the normal barrel, but rolls faster than it. Starts spawning after 20 seconds. Deals -1 HP.

HEAVY BARREL (salmon): Falls faster than the normal barrel, but rolls slower than it. Starts spawning after 20 seconds. Deals -2 HP due to how bulky it is, even when slowly rolling.

PAUSE BARREL (dark green): Pauses the player in place when this barrel hits them. The player would be unpaused when they get hit by another barrel. Starts spawning after 45 seconds. It does not deal damage unless the player is already paused and is hit by one. If it does deal damage to the player, then it would deal -1 HP.

BOUNCY BARREL (magenta): This barrel bounces on the platform. When it is falling, it bounces once, then falls. If it is rolling, then it will bounce on the platform until it reaches the other side. Starts spawning after 45 seconds. Deals -1 HP.

SPIKED BARREL (maroon): Watch out for this barrel, as it can instantly knock you out of the game and make you lose! Starts spawning after a minute and 30 seconds.

WATER BARREL (blue/gray): This barrel can cause some trouble as it leaves a trail of water causing the floor to be slippery. This makes players more cautious as they have a bigger chance of getting squished by a barrel. Starts spawning after a minute. Deals -1 HP.

PALM TREE BARREL (taupe): This barrel spawns as normal and once it touches the ground or a player, a palm tree is planted in the middle of the field, launching or knocking back anyone that gets caught in the landing. The palm tree acts like a barrier to prevent the player from moving to a new place. Starts spawning after a minute.

GEYSER BARREL (light blue): This barrel spawns as normal and once it touches the ground or a player, a geyser occurs, launching the player twice as high as a palm tree would. Starts spawning after a minute and 30 seconds.

BEACH BALL BARREL (clear): This barrel and its beach balls can release cause some trouble that once it touches the ground or a player, 3 beach balls bounce around the field, knocking back players that gets caught in their landing. Starts spawning after a minute and 30 seconds. Deals -1 HP, if it is a falling barrel.

7q5$V:AVqR]9=BTmSkiq.text:
Due to the beachside theme of this AY-minigame-spinoff, it's recommended for most of the music you add to have summery, tropical themes to them, with tropical instruments such as steel drums, marimba, ukulele, timbales, congas and bongos... or at least an upbeat atmosphere of 'sunshine'. Pirate-ish music can work too!
If you want to add your own music, separate your song into it's intro (if it has an intro) and it's looping part in separate sounds, tag "-Start" at the end of the intro's name, then tag "-Loop" at the end of the looping part's name. (Jingles won't have these tags, as they aren't intended to loop.) Add the song's name into the "Add music" block that matches which scenario it's for, and drop it here! Remember that EVERYTHING must have correct spelling or else it won't work! If you're unsure, testing is recommended.

If the music track or jingle comes from a party game, like Mario Party, Wii Party or WarioWare: MEGA Party Game$, make sure it won't play for users who don't want those music tracks, like SmashBrosFan2020, via the audio-exemption lists & boolean. Same goes for "gets faster" tracks, lyrical music, Flash/HTML5 game music, Miitopia music & non-looping music. 

I recommend you please don't add any more than around 80 music tracks and jingles total, to prevent lag or the dreaded "refusal-to-save glitch" when modifiying the project on less powerful devices. It's also best to refrain from adding too many music tracks longer than 3 minutes (180 seconds) or too many "gets faster" tracks.

Set your character's name, how many footstep sounds they have, interval between Run-frame progression, the number of ouch voice clips, and their size here. Fine-tune these things to your liking. The amount of Run-frames you add is calculated automatically now.

NOTICE: If you don't change the character's name from "[ NAME HERE ]" they will not participate in the game! Also, It's recommended you put at least a little bit of color on your character so we can tell if they've been made black-n-white by a Pause Barrel.

Setting the Seconds per Run-frame to a negative value will result in the Run animation being faster than 0 seconds per run frame. Silky smooth.

If you want to change your footstep sounds, find a footstep sound pack, and add it to your character. Make sure to set the footstep number accordingly based on how many your sound pack has.

If you don't want any seconds per frame, there is a custom block after this block that allows you to choose if you want to have seconds per walk frame or not, so you will have to reply with nothing or anything else to have no seconds per frame. 
If you answer Y, your character will have seconds per frame. Otherwise, anything else will not have any seconds per frame.
